About Sponsorship

Sponsor the PAWty

Every sponsorship helps fund The Fashion PAWty and supports the Eye Spy Foundation's mission to create a more accessible world for the blind and low vision community. Pick your package, put your brand at the center of the orange carpet, and help us reach our $25,000 goal.

Why Sponsor The Fashion PAWty?

Sponsorship dollars fund the Eye Spy Foundation and Leader Dogs for the Blind, helping the blind and low vision community navigate the world with more confidence — while putting your brand in front of an engaged Jacksonville audience.
